business_summary: Tyson Foods, Inc. (NYSE: TSN) is a diversified global protein company spanning chicken, beef, pork and prepared foods. On the h5n1-panzootic chain it sits on poultry-genetics through its wholly-owned Cobb-Vantress, Inc. subsidiary, one of only two or three companies worldwide supplying primary broiler breeding stock (trade press: 'All of the layer and turkey breeding stock and most broiler stock in the world now originates from only two companies,' Canadian Poultry Magazine, 2026-09-10, cited on the chain's own heat evidence). This is the ONLY listed route this census found into that link, and the chain's heat map scores it money_corner true (impact 90, crowdedness 8, capture 95, as of 2026-09-10): the breeding pyramid is measured in generations and cannot be rebuilt faster than genetics allow, and the duopoly holds near-total pricing power exactly when outbreaks force flock replacement. But TSN itself is a heavily diluted vehicle for that exposure: Cobb-Vantress sits inside a roughly $54.4bn-revenue diversified meat processor (FY2025 companyfacts), and no segment disclosure isolates its genetics revenue.

exposure_summary.narrative: TSN holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (poultry-genetics, link position 4, UNDISCOVERED, money_corner true, HIGH-scoring bottleneck per the chain's capture score of 95). No Cobb-Vantress-specific or genetics-specific share of TSN's consolidated revenue is disclosed; Tyson reports by protein segment (Chicken, Beef, Pork, Prepared Foods, International), not by breeding-stock subsidiary.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No h5n1-panzootic-specific or poultry-genetics-specific share of TYSON-FOODS's revenue is disclosed or sourced this run.
